meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 在你构建或改造网页界面时,Claude 会先明确主题、受众和页面任务,再拿出一份包含配色、字体、布局和标志性元素的设计方案,并检查方案是否落入常见模板套路。写代码时会兼顾移动端适配、键盘焦点和减少动效的偏好,文案也从用户视角书写。
howto.when: 当你要求新建或改造网页界面时,该技能会接管。比如从零设计一个页面、调整现有界面的视觉风格,或规划布局与配色。

say.text: 帮我设计一个独立音乐人主页,要有独特视觉风格,不要模板感。
say.note: Claude 会先给出设计计划再写代码。

say.text: 改造现有的博客页面,重新搭配字体和排版。
say.note: 它会先评估当前设计并提出修改方案。

say.text: 做一个手工陶瓷品牌的产品展示页,包含动效方案。
say.note: 它会结合主题特征构思标志性元素。

howto.what_en: Claude makes web UI distinctive: it defines subject, audience, and page job, proposes palette, type, layout, and a signature element, checks for templated defaults, then builds with responsive, accessible, motion-safe code and user-side copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or reshape a web UI—e.g., designing a new page, restyling an interface, or planning layout and palette.

say_en.text: Design an indie musician's homepage with a distinctive, non-templated look.
say_en.note: It will present a design plan before writing code.

say_en.text: Restyle my existing blog page with new type and layout.
say_en.note: It will review the current design and propose changes.

say_en.text: Create a product page for handmade ceramics, with a motion concept.
say_en.note: It will tie the signature element to the subject's world.
